name: switchbooks
description:
Your ULTIMATE AI bookkeeper and accountant. Just tell it what you want to get done.

Do your bookkeeping with a prompt. Switchbooks brings AI accounting and bookkeeping to small businesses. Categorize and post transactions, reconcile bank accounts and credit cards, and create journal entries through conversation.

Understand your finances and reports with profit and loss (P&L), balance sheets, and cash flow reports.

To get started, there are two simple steps: 1. Connect your bank accounts and credit cards in Switchbooks, and 2) Connect Switchbooks to your AI assistant. Enable bookkeeping changes when connecting.

Other prompts to try:

- “Get my books ready for month-end.” Find uncategorized transactions, possible duplicates, and anything that needs my attention. Help me work through it.
- “My revenue is up—why is there less cash in the bank?” Walk me through where the money went.
- “Show me where my business is leaking money.” Find rising expenses, recurring subscriptions, and unusual spending worth investigating.
- “Clean up my books.” Review my uncategorized transactions, propose the right categories, and apply the changes I approve.
- “Which of my businesses is performing best?” Compare revenue, profit margins, and expenses across my companies. Show me what’s driving the differences.
- “Help me reconcile my bank accounts and credit cards.” Find what doesn’t match and walk me through resolving it.
- “Give me a CFO-style briefing for this month.” Explain what changed, what drove it, and the three things I should investigate first.
